title: Late Fees and the Finch Circle Card Floor Allowance Share — Training Questions
content:
**Rule.** For a card floor in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program, the floor allowance standing share is the whole (1) when no late fee was charged on the customer's Marlowe & Finch card accounts within the last 12 whole months, one half (0.5) when exactly one was, and none (0) when two or more were.

**Where is this read?** From the fees charged on all of the customer's Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards accounts, counting only late fees, within the last 12 whole months.

**A customer had one late fee on the Store Card and none on the Mastercard in that time. What is the share?** One late fee in total: one half (0.5).

**Two late fees, one on each account?** Two or more: none (0).

**A late fee charged 14 months ago and none since?** It falls outside the last 12 whole months: the whole (1).

**Does an annual fee or a returned-payment fee count?** No; only late fees count.

| Late fees on the customer's Marlowe & Finch card accounts in the last 12 whole months | Floor allowance standing share |
|---|---|
| 0 | 1 |
| 1 | 0.5 |
| 2 or more | 0 |
